title: Microsoft Fabric Direct Lake - Simply Explained
description:
The fastest report in Microsoft Fabric might be showing you yesterday's numbers. For years, you had two choices, and both came with a catch.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why fast and fresh rarely happen together
  • The two choices Power BI has always given you
  • What Direct Lake actually is
  • How it works under the hood, in plain words
  • The two flavors of Direct Lake
  • Where Direct Lake fits in your Microsoft world
  • The mistakes that make Direct Lake feel slow
  • What to remember about Direct Lake

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
